No.

Animalism [Jyhad:C, VTES:C, Sabbat:C, SW:C/PT, FN:PR, CE:C]
Cardtype: Master
Capacity: +1
Master: Discipline.
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gains 1 level of Animalism
[ani]. Capacity increases by 1: the vampire is one generation older.
Cannot be <placed> on a vampire with superior Animalism.

Notice the absence of this text on Infernal Pact.
